review.scientific: Internal review of blood fractions, species-specific cell morphology, plasma/serum specimen distinction, albumin and immunoglobulin sources, fibrinogen conversion, binding-site occupancy, effective tonicity versus osmolality, macromolecular retention, classical/revised Starling physiology, open bicarbonate buffering and rheology. Quantitative checks include RBC 5 million/µL × 90 fL = 45%, pH 6.1 + log10(24/1.2) ≈ 7.40, 7 mmHg oncotic fall at Kf 0.010 gives +0.070 mL/min, and equal slope filtration graph. Reviewed 58 answer mappings. Distinguishes schematic and hypothetical data from published evidence; neighboring haemopoiesis, coagulation and volume control deferred.
review.editorial: Separate internal pass checked 16 progressive theory sections, 147 nonduplicate teaching paragraphs, 15 sequential numbered accessible SVGs, 8 comparison/data tables, 58 explained questions (22 B, 26 C, 10 other), 18 misconception corrections, 14 recall items, revision equations and glossary. Existing reader architecture copied and adjusted only for target; checked section hierarchy, internal anchors, zoom IDs, HTML tag balance and script parsing. Corrected figure ordering, refined graph and revision comparison.

Coverage, depth, pedagogy, experimental reasoning and revision supported by chapter contents and measured structure.
